prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semesters according to the study plan.
Recommended: Knowledge in Mathematics, Transport Phenomena, and Fundamentals of Process Engineering, as taught in basic mechanical engineering lectures.

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess the methodological foundations for calculating and simulating technical systems in MATLAB/SIMULINK.
They know application examples and are able to independently implement simple tasks in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the basic functionality of MATLAB and the structure of the user interface.
In-depth treatment of different aspects of the software relevant to engineering.
Application of learned material in exercises.
Real application examples from the chosen specialization direction.
Presentation and testing of a current and important software from process engineering with simple exercises, OR
Development and calculation of more comprehensive examples with MATLAB under supervision.
assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points occurs when the module final examination is passed. The module is weighted by its number of credit points (factor: 1).
